title: Mushroom Pilaf with Kissed Russian Twist
description: A flavorful pilaf dish with mushrooms and a hint of roasted Russian flavors, kissed with a delicate touch.

ingredients.name: Kissed Russian Seasoning
ingredients.notes: Homemade blend of paprika, dill, parsley

instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the toasted Russian Black Bread and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
4. In a separate pan, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat.
5. Add the uncooked pilaf and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
6. In a large bowl, combine the cooked pilaf, mushroom mixture, and Roasted Garlic Mayonnaise. Stir until well combined.
7. Season with Kissed Russian Seasoning, salt, and pepper to taste.
9. Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
10. For homemade Roasted Garlic Mayonnaise, see notes
